title: PlacementCapacity
description: What a carrier offers to spend, or has left to spend, as optional ceilings: bytes, memory bytes, CPU milliseconds and process ids. Each field is always written and is null when that dimension is not offered or not bounded (one provenance: a berth whose manifest declares no envelope has null fields; nothing is null because it could not be asked). Integers, never floats (rail R-P3 covers ranking; capacity is charged in whole units). Lives in objects/ because two intents carry it (a posture's offer terms and a berth offer) and the TypeScript codegen resolves cross-file references into objects/ but not into intents/. Wire shape: this schema is the source of record; placement_core::Capacity (elohim/placement/core/src/offer.rs) is its Rust mirror, not yet pinned to it by a test; ark-core maps ResourceQuota onto it (disk_bytes to bytes). Source of truth: the carrier that offers it (Category C as a value); it travels inside a posture or berth offer.

bytes.description: Disk bytes. A u64 in Rust, bounded here to 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1, the largest integer every JSON reader, JavaScript included, holds exactly); a larger value is refused, never rounded.

memoryBytes.description: A u64 in Rust, bounded here to 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1, the largest integer every JSON reader, JavaScript included, holds exactly); a larger value is refused, never rounded.
